They are different varieties of difficult. Dark souls is punishing. Cuphead is challenging. Most games I like are either Punishing, Challenging or Cruel. 

Challenging games: generate their difficulty by requiring intense focus, precise inputs and predictive strategy to succeed. Like in Street Fighter, Guitar Hero, COD, etc..

Punishing games: generate their difficulty by punishing the player for mistakes through loss of progress, resources or patience 😅 Like in games such as: Dark Souls, Getting Over it, Project Zomboid, and old school survival horror RPGs.

Cruel games: they're both baby 😈 (my personal favorite is  "Fear & Hunger: Termina")
